sections: ClawQL is the secure, persistent MCP gateway for production agents — search and execute across OpenAPI, Discovery, and optional GraphQL/gRPC sources, with always-on audit and cache, optional vault memory, and defense-in-depth controls.

Everything flows through one intelligent gateway. Disabled components cost nothing. Official artifacts verify against Layer 0 immutable releases. Start with the Vision & Roadmap, then the Master enablement guide for the full 6-layer architecture.
